WASHINGTON, Oct 26 (Reuters) - US President Donald Trump's public approval rating inched higher to 32%, ‌up a percentage point from last week's record low, ahead of the November 3 midterm elections that will decide which party controls Congress, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll completed on Monday.

Trump's fellow Republicans are fighting to retain the party's majorities in the House of Representatives and Senate.
